annotations.ce_understood_harm: the one I love is struck and dies right there

annotations.pda_responsibility: their life ends because of my hand

annotations.ce_understood_harm: someone I love is killed, a permanent loss

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Flipping that lever kills the person I love.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: loyalty is a real duty with its own weight

annotations.ce_understood_harm: send the train into someone I love, and they wouldn't walk away
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: I'm clear-headed, just unwilling to commit.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My usual rule is never to actively redirect danger.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: It's only because my pull actually saves them that an exception is even on the table.
